notes: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί compressed to Brethren; Ἄνδρες left unrepresented rather than joined to ἀδελφοί, since ἀδελφοί alone carries the one English word.
SBLGNT.ACT.23.1.v001 underdetermined to base; no English is affected.
ἀτενίζω governs the bare dative τῷ συνεδρίῳ and the ASV writes a determiner for it, so on the rides with the article under rules 21 and 106 rather than with the verb.
